query: Draft a short announcement that the cafeteria will close at 3pm on Friday for maintenance.
styleGuide: Plain language, friendly tone, under 80 words, lead with what changes and when, no exclamation marks.
response: The cafeteria will close at 3pm this Friday for scheduled maintenance. It reopens at the usual time on Monday. Vending machines on each floor stay available. Thank you for your patience.

query: Announce the new hybrid working guidelines published on the intranet.
styleGuide: Plain language, friendly tone, under 80 words, lead with what changes and when, no exclamation marks.
response: Our updated hybrid working guidelines are now on the intranet. They explain how to agree on office days with your team and how to book desks. Please read them before the end of the month and speak to your manager with any questions.

query: Remind everyone to complete the annual security training.
styleGuide: Plain language, friendly tone, under 80 words, lead with what changes and when, no exclamation marks.
response: Reminder: annual security training is due by 30 November. It takes about 25 minutes and is available in the learning portal. Completing it helps keep our systems and data safe.
